page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. This KVM-based instance features 2 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 2 vCPUs. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, and the baseline network bandwidth is specified at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.se1.large in the lower performance tiers. The single-core CPU performance measured via stress-ng is 1098.69, which is categorized in the bottom 25%, while the multi-core CPU score of 1458.9 falls into the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 81.55 GB/sec, but uncached large block read and write speeds drop significantly to 10.74 GB/sec and 9.67 GB/sec respectively. Geekbench and Passmark scores consistently rank in the bottom 10%, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 1092.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 1830.58.

From a resource density perspective, the instance offers a memory-optimized profile with 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring more memory than raw compute power. However, the lack of local storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps represent significant architectural tradeoffs. Given the poor benchmark results across database operations, static web serving, and Redis SET operations, this instance is best suited for lightweight memory-bound tasks, basic caching, or development environments rather than high-throughput production databases or intensive computational workloads.
